name: eggd_fgbio
title: eggd_fgbio
summary: fgbio 4.1.1 ClipBam: soft-clip overlapping read pairs in a BAM (AMBER input, Atlas CNV workflow)

inputSpec.name: bam
inputSpec.label: Coordinate-sorted BAM
inputSpec.help: Paired-end BAM to clip. Its index is not needed.

inputSpec.name: reference_fasta
inputSpec.label: Reference FASTA the BAM is aligned to
inputSpec.help: Plain or bgzipped FASTA. A sequence dictionary is made on the worker.

inputSpec.name: reference_fai
inputSpec.label: FASTA index (<reference_fasta>.fai)
inputSpec.help: Must be named after reference_fasta, with .fai added.

inputSpec.name: reference_gzi
inputSpec.label: bgzip index (<reference_fasta>.gzi)
inputSpec.help: Required when reference_fasta is bgzipped; named after reference_fasta, with .gzi added.

inputSpec.name: output_prefix
inputSpec.label: Output file prefix
inputSpec.help: Defaults to the BAM name without .bam. Outputs are <prefix>.clipped.bam, .clipped.bam.bai, .clipbam_metrics.txt and .provenance.tsv.

outputSpec.name: provenance
outputSpec.label: Versions, image, settings, runtime and record counts
